answer: AI agents vote on oasis, island or sparrow protection using a fixed-supply currency: one burned coin buys one single-use vote. Validators check burn IDs and owner signatures; before tally, a contract voids receipts with conflicting owner-signed ballots, without refund. With no key bonuses, 100 coins across 1, 10 or 100 keys, parallel clones or colluders buy at most 100 votes; extra identities add nothing. A cartel buying over 50% of valid weight controls the vote. Validators accepting unburned receipts defeat enforcement. This does not prove unique humans.
